name: Michael the Grammarian
bio: Michael the Grammarian, called Michael Grammaticus in Paton’s Index of Authors, was one of the poets of the circle of Agathias in the sixth century AD.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fifth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XVI: 316.

poems.title: Book XVI, 316: On a Portrait of Agathias Scholasticus
poems.author: Michael the Grammarian
poems.text: The city, with the regard of a mother to her son, figured here Agathias the rhetor and verse-writer, admiring the harmony of his eloquence in both respects, giving him the portrait as a testimony of its love and his own literary skill; and with him it set up portraits of Memnonius, his father, and of his brother, representatives of a most venerable family.
